Chronostratigraphy.allConcept:
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX ex: <${prefix}/Chronostratigraphy/>

SELECT ?term ?prefLabel
WHERE {
 ?term a skos:Concept . 
 ?term skos:prefLabel ?prefLabel . 
 FILTER(LANG(?prefLabel) = 'en') 
}
